title: Positive: order journey is correct and safe end to end (24/24 checks)
expected: Server-side pricing, stock and state; only the right party acts.
actual: Invalid quantities (0, -1, 1.5, over stock, 10001, injected text) and phones rejected; client price ignored; stock reserved in the order transaction; two concurrent orders for the last unit → exactly one succeeds, stock 0; only the seller confirms, once (409 on repeat); unrelated users and guests refused; guest order link is a 43-char token, altered tokens 404, no internal fields exposed; Amharic and emoji names round-trip; a browser double-click on 'Place order' creates one order.
impact: Keep; promote the script to a CI test.
